title: The Evolution of Forensic Genetics and Its Applications in Criminal Case Investigation in the United States
content: While the UK was the first country to solve a case using traditional DNA fingerprinting,advanced forensic genetic methods were more prominent in the USA. This article addressesadvancements in forensic genetics that have helped solve important criminal cases in the USA.This can be seen with the introduction of methods like FIGG and the combination of factorssuch as hair, location and age to help solve the case of the Golden State Killer, which laterinspired European countries like Sweden to do the same. The article focuses on the USAspecifically because of the fact that it has made some of the major advancements in the forensicgenetics field, and these methods continue to gain more prominence while addressing casesthat had seemed “unsolvable”. While forensic genetics has gained a lot of popularity, its use,particularly in cold case investigations, still raises many privacy and social concerns in theUSA, as these companies might actually use their DNA without their consent. The mainobjectives of this review paper are to explore the advancements, historical background and howbiology and chemistry have been instrumental in the advancement of this field while keepingin mind their social and ethical considerations.
